source.stem:
Which of the following options regarding Darwin’s theory of natural selection is incorrect ( )
A. All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
B. If living things want to survive, they must fight for survival in order to obtain food and space.
C. Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
D. Organisms that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

options.text: All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
If living things want to survive, they have to fight for food and space.
Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
Creatures that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

hinge.title: Explain why traditional foods differ across Indian states by relating them to locally grown crops, taste preferences, culture, and traditions.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: States growing the same crops must have the same traditional foods.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A state's traditional foods determine its crops, tastes and traditions, rather than those factors shaping its traditional foods.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Everyone in a state eats the same traditional food.

intelligence.enrichment: Traditional food in a state is usually based on crops grown in that state, and food choice also varies with taste preferences, culture, and traditions. local crop cultivation plus taste preferences plus culture and traditions -> regional differences in traditional food The learner correctly applies this rule: Traditional food in a state is usually based on crops grown in that state, and food choice also varies with taste preferences, culture, and traditions. A state has one fixed traditional food because everyone there eats the same thing.
